query: How do I create a simple finger painting?

goal.title: Finger-paint small orange flowers on paper
goal.description: Prepare orange, green and brown paint in separate dishes, dilute it with a brush, then use fingertips to stamp orange petal clusters, brown centers and green leaf marks on textured paper. Clean fingertips and a paint dish while adding final green marks.
goal.final_state: The paper carries several orange flowers with brown centers and green leaves; the brown paint dish is mostly wiped clean.
procedure: Place paper and dispense orange paint onto a plastic palette.
Wet a brush and test the paint, then wipe the palette and set out three small dishes.
Dispense orange, green and brown paints into separate dishes and mix each with water.
Dip fingertips into orange paint and stamp petal clusters across the paper.
Add brown flower centers and green leaf marks with fingertips, wiping fingers between colors.
Wipe out the brown paint dish and add finishing green marks to the picture.

phases.description: Paper is positioned, orange paint dispensed, and a wetted brush used on a plastic palette before the palette is wiped clean and moved aside.
Three small dishes are set out and orange, green and brown paints squeezed into them, with tubes recapped after each color.
The brush alternates between the water tray and orange, green and brown dishes, stirring the paint before being rested across the tray.
A fingertip is dipped in orange paint and pressed repeatedly onto paper; more orange is added before several groups of petal marks are built.
Brown paint is replenished and a fingertip touches the centers of orange petal groups, with wiping between dabs.
Green paint is replenished, fingertip marks added between the flowers and near their edges, and the painting briefly lifted and moved aside.
A tissue is wetted and used on fingertips, then repeatedly rubbed inside the brown dish. Cleaner tissue is taken and dishes repositioned.
The paper is brought forward, green marks added, the sheet lifted for inspection and fingertips wiped again.
